description: Your outcomes: decisions Trustpilot made on your filed cases (removed, retained, amended, withdrawn), the win rate and median days to a decision computed from those decisions, the same per Trustpilot reason the reports were filed under, and removals: how many reviews Trustpilot removed after your reports, how many of those RepuTend has since seen gone from Trustpilot, and reviews that disappeared with no removal by Trustpilot recorded (their reviewer may have deleted them). Every review you approved or reported that is gone from Trustpilot is charged as a removal, however it went; a review you never approved or reported never is. (capability: outcomes.read_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: get_outcomes
